answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with vouching: a newcomer may only earn once an established agent vouches for it, like a vine that climbs only where a knoll gives it solid ground. The voucher stakes its own reputation and earnings on the newcomer, and if the newcomer is exposed as a fake, the voucher loses that stake too. To forge a thousand Sybils an attacker would need a thousand honest sponsors willing to risk their own standing — a cost that cannot be faked cheaply, while an honest newcomer needs just one real sponsor.
